purpose: Implementation planning coverage, not a compatibility result or test certificate

statusMeaning.partial: Some related local capability exists; no API or behavior parity claimed
statusMeaning.missing: No implementation of the named responsibility found in the inspected local source

localBaseline.scope: Working branch including subsequent record milestone changes beyond the recorded baseline; not necessarily merged main or published npm

modules.gap: Exact rational/algebraic arithmetic, canonical equation bases, and correlated linear/quadratic fiber reconstruction exist; general rounded intervals, transcendental enclosures and a certified approximation policy remain incomplete.
Exact vectors, planes and cylinders exist; a complete analytic surface family and common transform/placement API are missing.

Positive rational weights, evaluation, derivatives, knot operations and sufficient affine/triangular face-embedding certificates exist. A rational-weight cylinder wall/cap path now has fixed integration coverage. General fitting, degree editing, complete embedding tests and broad imported-data coverage remain missing.

Exact geometry/topology records and supported analytic face definitions exist; constructed NURBS source BRep recipes replay source/target and both trim domains without serialized certification claims. Arbitrary imported NURBS/procedural domains, independent pcurves and persistent feature IDs remain incomplete. A NURBS Body recipe document now replays all source faces, sewing, global embedding, containment, orientation and region-sample checks through common Body restoration. Optional rational separation planes are untrusted search hints checked against whole finite faces during replay; they are not stored proof flags.

Certified finite source faces enter shared incidence and supported rational maps sew across sources. Sufficient pairwise separation certificates now gate global embeddings, containment forests and alternating material orientation. Complete general embedding discovery, general SSI maps and full NURBS operation dispatch remain incomplete.

Supported analytic domains and constructed NURBS source recipes reconstruct geometry and re-run applicable face and boundary checks. Weighted wall/circular-cap recipes rebuild exact sewn queries in regression. Arbitrary imported face/shell certification, independent pcurves, complete imported-data void containment and full NURBS operation dispatch remain incomplete.

Box, finite/clipped Cylinder, vertical Extrude, planar materials, manifold finite-cylinder expressions and repeated halfspace-clipped expressions share owned Body records, derived regions, bounded-face queries and replay-checked persistence. Restored cylinder-family Bodies can append cuts. Clipped-leaf Boolean reuse, general curved operations, arbitrary record-to-solid certification and feature history remain missing. Certified NURBS materials now join KernelBody3 with owned topology, cavity-aware region samples, point/face/line/ray queries and replayed source-only persistence. NURBS similarity transforms now rebuild exact source/target controls, flip reflected face senses, and revalidate covariantly transformed separation-plane hints. General NURBS Booleans, splitting, arbitrary affine transforms and mass properties remain incomplete.
A common axis-aligned Box/finite Cylinder API and vertical profile Extrude exist. Complete sphere/cone/torus/pyramid constructors and broader placements remain missing.

Owned cylinder walls and planar caps support multi-cylinder/plane arrangements, exact side vectors and bounded-domain replay. Arbitrary NURBS spatial face topology and general curved trimming remain incomplete.

Native analytic and existing NURBS intersections coexist with owned cylinder SSI graphs, exact plane trims and third-cylinder SSI recovery. Finite-cylinder expression plane sections and closed cut boundaries exist. General analytic/NURBS SSI, complete contact relations and broader clipped-material operations remain incomplete. Certified finite NURBS faces now expose exact plane-section vertices, trimmed implicit graph intervals and coplanar finite-face domains, including holes and isolated contacts. Complete cross-face noding, cap material selection and NURBS Body plane splitting remain incomplete.

Finite-cylinder wall/cap partitions select and sew balanced native/SSI Boolean boundaries with supported common Body persistence. Shared bounded native curve events retain source indexes; upstream cuts feed native and mixed sewing. Finite coplanar lines/conic arcs now enter the common planar strip decomposition, including finite face sections and dangling endpoints. Artificial vertical edges remain. General curved face insertion, complete material-side certification, repeated general curved cuts and maximal consolidation remain incomplete. Owned open planar cells now undergo complete plane/cylinder support-zero checks before two-sided material evaluation and oriented boundary selection/sewing. A finite cylinder cap/wall reconstruction verifies closed incidence; general curved-side selection, global coverage and embedded solid adoption remain incomplete. Missing planar support cuts can now be inserted automatically with reclassification and parent-cell provenance; generic curved refinement and full solid adoption remain incomplete. All candidate planar supports of owned cylinder/halfspace material now share partition, zero checking, refinement, material selection and sewing, with coincident support origins retained. Focused cases close against curved sides and validate an all-planar box through common Body replay; generic curved boundary extraction and global solid certification remain incomplete. Owned cylinder wall arrangements now share strict two-sided material evaluation and finite-band-aware coincident ownership, selecting native/SSI boundaries with provenance and nonmanifold diagnostics. General trimmed analytic/NURBS surfaces and embedded solid adoption remain incomplete. One assembly API now combines planar/cylinder selections with complete face provenance, balanced edge checks and strict incidence or nonmanifold diagnostics. Independent material-program ownership, arbitrary curved embeddings and common Body adoption remain incomplete. Certified NURBS material boundaries now aggregate finite-face plane loci, weld algebraic endpoints, retain coplanar domains and report endpoint-graph cycles with contact diagnostics. These cycles are not oriented cap certificates; complete overlap noding, planar material selection and closed child-Body construction remain incomplete. A sufficient transverse-section certificate now orients every native curve edge with material on the left, checks complete derivative-zero cuts and endpoint gradients, and validates oriented cycle continuity. Degenerate sections remain explicit; filled cap domains and certified child Bodies remain incomplete. An exact implicit cap domain now maps original section edges to an oriented rational plane chart and queries closed material membership including cavities and islands. Explicit cap cells, face adoption and child-Body sewing remain incomplete. Finite source faces now expose exact open UV strip cells with constant plane sign and constructive interior evaluation, retaining finite trim membership. Closed-cell adjacency, event-fiber adoption and shared section-edge sewing remain incomplete. Each open strip now exposes an exact positively oriented closed UV boundary, with projection-event sides noded at all arrangement vertices and collapsed sides omitted. Cross-cell sharing, seam consolidation and child-Body certification remain incomplete. Within each source patch arrangement, exact curve-interval incidence now joins adjacent cells, cancels equal-sign seams, and extracts oriented region boundary cycles when incidence is simple. Cross-patch sharing, cap adoption and child-Body certification remain incomplete. Constant-coordinate seams across patches of one finite face are now noded by exact endpoint unions, welded with full spatial equality checks, and joined before equal-sign region extraction. Arbitrary cross-face parameter correspondence, cap adoption and child-Body certification remain incomplete. Existing sewn source edges now refine at every exact plane root, including even-multiplicity tangencies and coplanar spans, with all original coedge uses expanded to the same canonical fragments and incidence rechecked. Interior face splitting, full cell-to-original-edge correspondence and capped child Bodies remain incomplete. Exact finite shared-edge point inverses now map owned cell vertices to incident original edge fragments, retaining topology vertex IDs or interior extra-cut parameters after full XYZ checks. This is point correspondence; whole-curve matching, additional edge refinement and capped child Bodies remain incomplete. Matched cell vertex parameters can now re-refine canonical shared edges while retaining all old cuts and both face uses; rebound correspondences verify every matched vertex is a topology vertex. Whole-curve correspondence and capped child Bodies remain incomplete. A reusable rational-span interval matcher now certifies full XYZ parameter relations, both interval projections and consistent orientation, including algebraic endpoints and nonlinear reparameterization. General implicit cell-boundary extraction, integration of whole-curve source correspondence and capped child Bodies remain incomplete. Constant rational-UV cell boundary paths now extract exact spatial curves and use full interval relations to match original shared curves and ordered refined-fragment coverage. General implicit trim paths remain explicit unresolved entries; full shared boundary noding and capped child Bodies remain incomplete.

Owned planar and finite-cylinder material supports exact queries, shell regions and common Body replay, including repeated halfspace clipping. Bounded cylinder/plane predicates now preserve operand-local cuts through common Body Booleans, derived regions, complete domain persistence and replay/reuse. Nonmanifold material remains lower-level only. An exact six-plane box bridge now composes with cylinder materials at the kernel boundary layer. Native owned/restored Box Bodies now compose with cylinder-family Bodies through booleanMixedBodies3 and replayable material recipes. An owned convex single-shell planar-material bridge now derives exact supporting halfspaces; actual convex planar/consolidated Body sources now enter mixed Booleans with complete replay. General owned planar material now also compiles from physical-plane chambers and constructs sewn boundaries with common Body replay; focused cases include concavity, nested cavities/islands/disconnected shells and through-holes. Native planar/consolidated mixed Body dispatch uses convex supports or chambers; five focused native concave/disconnected/void/empty composition, replay and repeated-cut cases passed. Actual owned planar pairs now dispatch to the checked native planar Boolean kernel with focused regularized shared-plane contact, replay and subsequent cylinder-reuse checks. Actual owned/restored straight-profile product Extrude now lowers through exact planar conversion, including through-hole and reversed real-cylinder composition in focused tests. Actual normalized circular-loop product Extrude now lowers to finite-cylinder parity with owned product provenance and exact full-circle coverage checks, including annuli, islands/disconnected components and non-unit-axis spatial composition in focused cases. General arc-line and different-circle arc product lowering remains incomplete. Broader mixed contact coverage, maximal curved consolidation and general analytic/NURBS Booleans remain incomplete. Exact two-sided straight germs of planes/cylinders are shared with material boundary queries; these point germs do not certify a whole partition cell.
Vertical line/circular-profile extrusion exists; general revolve, path sweep, loft and procedural definitions are missing.
No general fillet/chamfer or rolling-ball construction.
No general surface offset or solid shell/thickness operation.
No general imported-body healing or tolerance-aware repair.

Owned rational planar material now supports exact volume, centroid and unit-density origin/central inertia, including cavities, islands, disconnected material, native/wrapped planar Body variants and replayed Boolean results in focused cases. Curved-body volume/area/centroid/inertia, general surface area and certified integration remain incomplete.

Certified finite NURBS face evaluation, inverse membership and line/ray sections now feed owned globally embedded material boundaries. Budgeted rational ray retries, containment/orientation, rational and algebraic material membership, and closed line-material intervals with isolated tangent contacts and boundary-contained spans exist. General nearest-point/measurement families, complete arbitrary imported shell certification, full NURBS operation dispatch and general NURBS Booleans remain incomplete. Degenerate boundary provenance is retained; unresolved computations are propagated. Certified triangular coordinates and independent product projections now precondition source-face inverse queries, with full original XYZ checks retained. Owned finite-face plane section evaluators preserve native UV graph parameters, finite trim/approached-patch membership and full spatial plane equality.
Planar polygon triangulation and polygon extrusion meshes exist; watertight analytic/NURBS face tessellation with bounds is missing.
No STEP importer/exporter or assembly translation.
Geometry primitives exist; constraint solving and a parameterized sketch document are missing.
No feature history, parameter expression evaluation or incremental regeneration.
No shared command/session API, CLI command catalog or MCP integration.
Desktop/browser application, assemblies and product workflows remain later scope; no UI reuse is planned.

nurbsIntegrationEvidence.scope: Constructed positively certified finite NURBS faces and disjoint embedded shells, with sufficient material certification and exact queries; no full SolidCraft parity or arbitrary imported-material certification
